message: Tap a card in your hand, then tap an empty lane to summon a creature.
Tap your creature, then tap the enemy lane to attack.
This card has Excavate — play it to look at the top of your deck.
Cards you don't take are Buried. Your Barrow count grows.
Before a duel, open your Rune Page to equip runes that change how you play.
Equip a rune into an empty slot. Runes are earned from excavation, never purchased.
You know enough to begin. Good luck, Delver.
